# Ownership map

<!-- agent-kit: generated by /setup-agents, updated by /add-agent.
     Keep in sync with .claude/ownership.json (machine-readable copy used by the dashboard). -->

Agents edit **only** their paths. Reading anything is allowed. Paths must not overlap.

| Owner | Paths | Quick check (own area only) |
|---|---|---|
| **orchestrator** (main session) | entry points, routing, DI/config, dependency manifests, contract source, `docs/`, `scripts/`, git | full check |
| **generated** (nobody edits) | — | — |

_Not configured yet — run `/setup-agents`._

## Build collisions
Parallel builds can lock output folders. If a quick check fails with a "file in use"/lock error, wait briefly and retry once; if it still fails, report it and stop — don't loop.
